an5.106:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme.
an5.106:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an5.106:2.1: ‘kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhikkhusaṅgho viharanto phāsu vihareyyā' ti?
an5.106:2.2: ‘Yato kho Ānanda bhikkhu attanā ca sīlasampanno hoti no paraṃ adhisīle sampavattā
an5.106:2.3: hoti. Ettāvatā pi kho Ānanda bhikkhusaṅgho viharanto phāsu vihareyyā 'ti.
an5.106:3.1: ‘Siyā pana bhante añño pi pariyāyo, yathā bhikkhusaṅgho viharanto phāsu vihareyyā' ti?
an5.106:3.3: ‘Yato kho Ānanda bhikkhu attanā ca sīlasampanno hoti no paraṃ adhisīle sampavattā hoti,
an5.106:3.5: Ettāvatā pi kho Ānanda bhikkhusaṅgho viharanto phāsu vihareyyā' ti.
an5.106:4.1: ‘Siyā pana bhante añño pi pariyāyo, yathā bhikkhusaṅgho viharanto phāsu vihareyyā' ti?
an5.106:4.3: ‘Yato kho Ānanda bhikkhu attanā ca sīlasampanno hoti no paraṃ adhisīle sampavattā hoti,
an5.106:4.5: appaññāto ca hoti tena ca appaññātikena no paritassati.
an5.106:4.6: Ettāvatā pi kho Ānanda bhikkhusaṅgho viharanto phāsu vihareyyā' ti.
an5.106:5.1: ‘Siyā pana bhante añño pi pariyāyo, yathā bhikkhusaṅgho viharanto phāsu vihareyyā' ti?
an5.106:5.3: ‘Yato kho Ānanda bhikkhu attanā ca sīlasampanno hoti no paraṃ adhisīle sampavattā hoti,
an5.106:5.5: appaññāto ca hoti tena ca appaññātikena no paritassati;
an5.106:5.6: catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ abhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
an5.106:5.7: Ettāvatā kho Ānanda bhikkhusaṅgho viharanto phāsu vihareyyā' ti.
an5.106:6.1: ‘Siyā pana bhante añño pi pariyāyo, yathā bhikkhusaṅgho viharanto phāsu vihareyyā' ti?
an5.106:6.3: ‘Yato kho Ānanda bhikkhu attanā ca sīlasampanno hoti no paraṃ adhisīle sampavattā hoti,
an5.106:6.5: appaññāto ca hoti tena ca appaññātikena no paritassati;
an5.106:6.6: catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ abhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī;
an5.106:6.7: āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an5.106:6.8: Ettāvatā kho Ānanda bhikkhusaṅgho viharanto phāsu vihareyya.
an5.106:7.1: Imamhā cāhaṃ Ānanda phāsuvihārā añño phāsuvihāro uttaritaro vā paṇītataro vā natthī ti vadāmī
